notes.title: "Within : Hannah's Journey" releases July 12 !
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello from DontTellGames ![/b]

[i]Thanks to everyone who wishlisted the game. It means a lot to me.[/i][/h1]

The game will therefore be released on July 12 at 8:00 p.m.

The weeks following the release will be dotted with corrective updates based on your feedback, and free content updates!

I plan to add more levels, free DLC and in the future paid DLC.

Upon release, a bundle will be available containing the game as well as the soundtrack.

I can't wait to see your feedback on the game, know that I did it alone with as much passion as possible, I can't wait to see what the game will become at your side, hoping that the "Within" franchise will go very far.

THANKS. <3
